function.name: GRAPHIC_SET
function.param: Number of graph inside of library
Type of attribute to modofy. It can be: Horizontal coordinate of the center Vertical coordinate of the center Current frame of the animation Current speed of the animation
New value to asign to the attribute
function.abstract: It allows to chagne an attribute of a graph

description.p: This function allows to access in runtime to determined attributes of a graph, specially of his animation. It can be used to select a concrete frame in the animated graphs, or change the speed of his animation, in miliseconds. For example, a speed of 0 stops the animation of a graph.
The animations of the MAP graphs are automatic, and independent of the frames per second established by the function .
